offering_hrms.name: HRMS
offering_hrms.tagline: Manage employees, payroll and labor compliance
offering_hrms.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "HRMS". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with workforce headcount
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and workforce headcount

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of workforce headcount
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of workforce headcount
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_hrms.costoNote: PILA/Aportes en Línea (~$30–$6,000 USD/mo) is paid by the customer directly to the provider.
